keyword.name: registerContextMenu

param.name: menus
param.desc: Registry object for managing context menu items, providing methods to register new menu entries

keyword.desc: Register custom context menu items for different Burp Suite components (e.g., message editor, selected text). Supports menu types including CARET, SELECTED_TEXT, REQUEST, REQUEST_RESPONSE, MESSAGE_EDITOR

keyword.name: passiveAudit

param.name: baseRequestResponse
param.desc: Request/response pair to analyze for potential security issues without sending additional requests

keyword.desc: Perform passive scanning checks by analyzing the content of requests and responses. Identifies vulnerabilities through static analysis without modifying or resending requests
keyword.returnValDesc: AuditResult containing any detected security issues from passive analysis

keyword.name: activeAudit

param.name: baseRequestResponse
param.desc: Base request/response pair to use as a template for active scanning

param.name: insertionPoint
param.desc: Specific location in the request where payloads will be injected for active testing

keyword.desc: Perform active scanning checks by injecting test payloads into specified insertion points and analyzing the resulting responses. Used to detect vulnerabilities that require interaction with the target
keyword.returnValDesc: AuditResult containing any detected security issues from active payload injection

keyword.name: handleRequest

param.name: request
param.desc: HTTP request object intercepted before being sent to the server

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Metadata (notes, tags) associated with the intercepted request

keyword.desc: Intercept and process HTTP requests. Allows modification of request content (headers, body, parameters) before they are forwarded to the target server
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified HttpRequest and updated Annotations

keyword.name: handleResponse

param.name: response
param.desc: HTTP response object intercepted after being received from the server

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Metadata (notes, tags) associated with the intercepted response

param.name: originalRequest
param.desc: The original HTTP request that corresponds to this response

keyword.desc: Intercept and process HTTP responses. Allows modification of response content (headers, body) before they are forwarded to the client
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified HttpResponse and updated Annotations

keyword.name: handleProxyRequest

param.name: request
param.desc: HTTP request object intercepted by Burp Proxy from the client

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Proxy-specific annotations for the intercepted request

keyword.desc: Specifically handle requests intercepted by Burp Proxy. Enables proxy-specific modifications and processing of client requests
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified proxy HttpRequest and updated Annotations

keyword.name: handleProxyResponse

param.name: response
param.desc: HTTP response object intercepted by Burp Proxy from the server

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Proxy-specific annotations for the intercepted response

param.name: originalRequest
param.desc: The original proxy request corresponding to this response

keyword.desc: Specifically handle responses intercepted by Burp Proxy. Enables proxy-specific modifications and processing of server responses
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified proxy HttpResponse and updated Annotations

keyword.name: urlPrefixAllowed

param.name: prefixes
param.desc: List of URL prefix strings to filter requests/responses

keyword.desc: Define URL prefixes to determine which requests/responses should be processed by the extension. Acts as a filter to limit extension activity to specific targets
keyword.returnValDesc: List of allowed URL prefix strings that the extension should process

keyword.name: handleInteraction

param.name: interaction
param.desc: (Interaction): Details of a Burp Collaborator interaction (DNS, HTTP, HTTPS) received from a target

keyword.desc: Process interactions detected by Burp Collaborator. Used to handle out-of-band (OOB) signals from targets, useful for detecting blind vulnerabilities

keyword.name: processPayload

param.name: payload
param.desc: Original payload string generated by Burp Intruder

keyword.desc: Modify or transform payloads before they are sent by Burp Intruder. Supports operations like encryption, encoding, or custom transformations of attack payloads
keyword.returnValDesc: Processed payload string to be used by Burp Intruder

keyword.name: handleWsTextMsg

param.name: message
param.desc: WebSocket text message intercepted in transit

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Annotations associated with the WebSocket text message

keyword.desc: Intercept and process WebSocket text messages. Allows modification of text-based WebSocket communication
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified WebSocket text message and updated Annotations

keyword.name: handleWsBinMsg

param.name: message
param.desc: WebSocket binary message intercepted in transit

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Annotations associated with the WebSocket binary message

keyword.desc: Intercept and process WebSocket binary messages. Allows modification of binary WebSocket communication
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified WebSocket binary message and updated Annotations

keyword.name: handleProxyWsTextMsg

param.name: message
param.desc: WebSocket text message intercepted by Burp Proxy

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Proxy-specific annotations for the WebSocket text message

keyword.desc: Specifically handle WebSocket text messages intercepted by Burp Proxy. Enables proxy-specific processing of text-based WebSocket traffic
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified proxy WebSocket text message and updated Annotations

keyword.name: handleProxyWsBinMsg

param.name: message
param.desc: WebSocket binary message intercepted by Burp Proxy

param.name: annotations
param.desc: Proxy-specific annotations for the WebSocket binary message

keyword.desc: Specifically handle WebSocket binary messages intercepted by Burp Proxy. Enables proxy-specific processing of binary WebSocket traffic
keyword.returnValDesc: Tuple containing the modified proxy WebSocket binary message and updated Annotations

keyword.name: finish
keyword.desc: Perform cleanup operations when the extension is stopped or unloaded. Used to release resources, close connections, or save state before extension termination
